title: Fluoride Bridges as Structure-Directing Motifs in 3d-4f Cluster Chemistry

synthesis.procedure: A solution of fac-[CrF3(Me3tacn)] (0.100 g, 0.36 mmol) in MeCN (10 mL) was allowed to diffuse through a porous glass frit (D4) into a solution of Nd(NO3)3·6H2O (0.205 g, 0.47 mmol) in MeCN (20 mL) at 5 °C. Over a period of days pink rod-shaped crystals of 14 develop. The crystals are often hollow and encapsulate mother liquor; upon drying they lose solvent and crumble. The best elemental analyses were obtained by gently crushing the crystalline product, repeated washing with MeCN, and storage below 0 °C.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: slow diffusion through a porous glass frit (D4)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Pink rod-shaped crystals form from the diffusion setup. Best analyses: gently crush crystals, wash repeatedly with MeCN, and store below 0 °C.
